## Name & positioning
- Product name: SaaSpend

## FAQ
Q1. What is SaaSpend?
A1. SaaSpend analyzes a SaaS inventory for overlaps and likely waste.
Q2. What do I paste in?
A2. A list of tools (and optional team size / notes).
Q3. Who should use it?
A3. Ops, IT, and finance partners cleaning software sprawl.
Q4. Does it cancel subscriptions?
A4. No. It recommends; you still own vendor cancellations.
Q5. Does it guarantee savings?
A5. No. Overlap detection helps prioritization; actual savings depend on contracts.
Q6. Is pricing scraped live?
A6. No. Treat any cost hints as estimates you must verify with invoices.
